title:
Please come along to our Craft Fair on Sunday, Dunelm Rochdale!  We have the most amazing wooden crafts on sale from benches, birdboxes, bug hotels, woodland crafts - here is a small selection!  And all made by our tenants and the amazing Pete.

We can only accept cash and we can take some commissions for a 50% deposit.  The money goes back into our charitable pot that enables us to buy materials and carry out more activities.
